jobs.description: Software Engineer, Infrastructure Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) Â· $185Kâ$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits Â About Sodalis Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait. Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist. We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx). Â The Opportunity Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own. We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live. We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range. You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture. What you'll do Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between. Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy. Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site. Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range. Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture. What we're looking for 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering. You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services. You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded. You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them. You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity. You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required. How we work We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. Weâre growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the role This is a hybrid sales and customer success role for someone with real scientific depth. You'll be the primary point of contact for customers â from first conversation through ongoing engagement. That means understanding what a protein design team is actually trying to achieve, helping them pick the right assays, making sure their experiments are set up correctly, and translating results back into language that's useful for their programs. The day-to-day: Running technical sales calls where you discuss binding kinetics, expression systems, and assay design, not just pricing Onboarding new customers and helping them design their first experiments on the platform Monitoring ongoing accounts, flagging issues early, and proactively suggesting next steps based on their results Working with the biology team to troubleshoot when a customer's experiment doesn't go as expected Identifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts â new targets, new assay types, larger campaigns You won't be handed a script. jobs.title: Director, Customer Compensation & Policy
jobs.description: <h2>About the Role&nbsp;</h2> <p>Within Global Customer Experience (GCX), our mission is to advance the HelloFresh customer relationship from reactive resolution to proactive, trust-building service. The compensation function sits at the heart of that mission: it is the mechanism through which the business acknowledges failures, restores customer confidence, and, when done well, turns a bad experience into a reason to stay.</p> <p>The Associate Director, Customer Compensation &amp; Policy is responsible for the global strategy, architecture, and governance of how HelloFresh compensates customers across all markets and brands. This is not a policy maintenance role. It is a strategic function that sits at the intersection of customer economics, operational data, behavioral experimentation, and cross-functional influence.</p> <p>You will own one of the most financially material and customer-sensitive levers in the business. You can go deep on API architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking constructively and turn technical constraints into product decisions. Strong execution and prioritisation. You can turn a focused roadmap into an actionable backlog, balance competing demands and keep delivery moving whilst protecting quality and long-term value. Platform thinking. jobs.title: Working Student - Media Design (f/m/d)
jobs.description: ZEAL Network SE is an international group shaping the future of digital lotteries and dream-driven experiences. As Germany’s leading online lottery provider through LOTTO24 and Tipp24, and a partner of Spain’s ONCE, ZEAL combines innovation, technology, and entertainment to inspire millions of customers. With ventures such as Freiheit+, Traumhausverlosung, Traumautoverlosung and ZEAL Ventures, the company also invests in new business models and emerging e-commerce brands. Driven by a diverse team of 350+ professionals, ZEAL fosters a collaborative, ambitious culture focused on turning dreams into reality. You will support the Games Team in creating, preparing, and presenting game-related media assets. That includes banners, promotional materials, and the visual presentation of our game portfolio, both internally and on social channels such as LinkedIn. You will work closely with the Team Lead Games, the Product Manager, and the Marketing Strategist, so your work fits our brand and our product positioning from day one. Your tasks: Design and produce visual assets such as game banners, promotional graphics, thumbnails, and portfolio visuals. Prepare launch materials for new games, including visuals for partner portals and marketing campaigns. Adapt existing assets for different formats and channels, such as mobile, desktop, and multiple languages. Create mood boards, UI mockups, and concept visuals for internal ideation and stakeholder presentations. Keep our internal game portfolio, presentation decks, and content libraries up to date. Make sure every visual reflects our brand guidelines and feels cohesive across the portfolio. Organize asset versions and file structures in shared tools such as Figma, Confluence, and our internal drives. Take on ad-hoc design requests from across the Games Team and supporting departments. What you offer us: Currently studying media design, visual communication, graphic design, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator) and/or Figma, or similar design tools. A solid grasp of visual hierarchy, layout, typography, and color. A portfolio of your design work (from studies, freelance, or personal projects) submitted with your application. Good attention to detail and the ability to manage several tasks in parallel. Clear communication, especially when giving and receiving feedback. Interest in gaming would be nice but experience in iGaming it not required. Basic knowledge of technical art, such as asset optimization or simple automation would be beneficial. Familiarity with presentation tools such as PowerPoint, Google Slides, or Keynote would be plus. What we offer: A modern, dynamic culture grounded in the success of a leading-edge e-commerce company. A talented team of ambitious, like-minded colleagues where your knowledge and ideas truly make an impact. Trust and autonomy, no micromanagement, just confidence in your ability to deliver and excel. Flexible work options with a hybrid setup focused on results. Opportunity for workations abroad using our WorkFlex tool. Monthly mobility allowance of €30 to use on the mobility option of your choice (e.g., the Deutschlandticket), plus access to a company bike leasing program. Company pension scheme, provided in partnership with Degura, to support your future financial security. Subsidized EGYM WELLPASS membership, with a contribution of only €25 per month, giving you access to a wide range of gyms and sports options across Germany. jobs.description: Website Growth & CRO Manager Full-time (40 hours per week), Hybrid (Berlin, Germany) About Us At The Global Talent Co., we provide opportunities to work with leading innovative technology companies worldwide, offering stable employment, competitive compensation, career growth, and access to a community of 25,000+ like-minded marketing professionals. About the Company You will be joining a fast-growing, founder-led European signage company that designs, produces and installs custom branded signs and visual identity systems for businesses of every size, from start-ups to global brands. Growing 40–50% year-on-year, the company is on its way to becoming the first marketing-led player in a complex, traditionally offline industry. Its websites and online configurators are where most customer journeys begin, so the focus now is on turning them into even stronger digital sales engines. The Role As Website Growth & CRO Manager, you will own the company’s websites, landing pages and lead funnels across its brands, and help shape the build of a new product configurator. This is a hands-on ownership role: you decide what to test, write the copy, shape the experience with a designer and AI tools, and turn data and customer insight into measurable gains in conversion. You’ll report to the CEO and work closely with Performance Marketing, Content, Design and Tech. This role is ideal for a creative, analytically strong and entrepreneurial marketer who wants to own conversion rates end to end and moves fast without waiting to be managed. Key Responsibilities Own and continuously improve the company’s websites, landing pages and conversion funnels Design intuitive, visually strong web experiences that convert, working alongside a designer and AI tools Plan, build and analyse A/B tests on full pages and individual sections Write sharp headlines, USPs, CTAs and website copy that turn visitors into customers Plan and develop SEO pages with support from the copywriting team Help shape the experience and build of a new online product configurator Run customer surveys and user research independently, and translate data and insights into prioritised growth experiments Drive execution across Performance Marketing, Content, Design and Tech, and report on the impact of every change Ideal Candidate 3–5 years of experience in digital product management, growth design, CRO or e-commerce; exceptional candidates with less experience and a strong track record are also welcome Native German speaker with professional English, as website copy is a core part of the role Based in Berlin or willing to relocate, for a hybrid set-up Excellent UX/UI understanding and a strong aesthetic sense A proven talent for concise, sales-driven web copy and persuasive messaging Strong analytical thinking and commercial understanding: you tie every change back to conversion and revenue Uses AI tools natively in day-to-day work, from research to copy to design Entrepreneurial and self-directed: sets clear priorities, owns outcomes and doesn’t wait to be told what’s next Tools & Stack Claude, Claude Code, n8n, make.com , Bitrix24 Join Our Team Be part of a collaborative, innovative environment where your technical skills and product instincts can make a real impact. Work with manufacturers and suppliers to make designs easier to build, and to balance cost, mass and reliability. Support prototype builds, integration and environmental test campaigns, iterating designs based on results. Collaborate with electrical, software, systems and thermal engineers to integrate mechanical components into the satellite platform. Clear communicator who is comfortable explaining and defending design decisions, and open to feedback and challenge in a fast-moving team. While the Tech Lead drives architectural decisions and manages the engineers, you will take full ownership of the team's backlog, feature planning, and post-deployment success. Because our current technical leadership leans heavily into complex systems architecture, we are looking for a proactive, communicative leader to champion Agile processes and cross-team relationships. jobs.title: Stage - Commercial·e / Sales / Business Developer
jobs.description: Le département Sales compte une trentaine de personnes réparties entre la qualification des prospects et le closing. Leur objectif commun : accompagner les prospects jusqu’à la signature du contrat en Assemblée Générale. Notre cycle de vente est long et complexe en BtoC (3 à 4 mois en moyenne). La particularité ? La copropriété doit voter à la majorité lors de son assemblée générale pour souscrire à notre solution. Tu rejoins l'équipe SDR, et ton objectif principal sera d'accompagner et de convaincre nos prospects à poursuivre le processus de vente en organisant des rendez-vous avec les Account Executives. En tant que SDR, tu représentes le premier contact client, tu es le premier maillon de notre processus de vente ; ainsi, tu participes activement à l'atteinte de nos objectifs commerciaux. En rejoignant le département Sales de Matera, tu auras l’opportunité d’échanger chaque jour avec des interlocuteurs très différents ! Il existe 600.000 copropriétés en France et chacune d’elle constitue une communauté à part entière, dont il nous faut comprendre le fonctionnement afin de les convaincre de nous rejoindre ! Nos prospects peuvent aussi bien être une petite copropriété de 3 lots en zone rurale, déjà autonome, qu’un grand ensemble immobilier de 300 logements en centre-ville, géré par un professionnel en face duquel nous présenterons une offre concurrente. Tes missions : En binôme avec nos commerciaux et sous la responsabilité de ton/ta manager, tu seras formé·e pour découvrir le métier de Sales Development Representative (SDR). Prendre en main la qualification : Réaliser les premiers échanges téléphoniques avec les prospects ayant formulé une demande de devis pour instaurer un premier contact de confiance. Comprendre les besoins : T’entraîner à analyser les problématiques rencontrées au sein des copropriétés et présenter les offres Matera. Assister les Account Executives : Participer à la prise de rendez-vous de démonstration et épauler les AE dans le suivi des prospects, la préparation des assemblées générales et les tâches administratives. Découvrir nos outils Sales : Participer à la tenue à jour de notre CRM (Hubspot) et appliquer les bonnes pratiques de suivi.Organiser des rendez-vous de démonstration avec les Account Executives, Contribuer à l’amélioration continue : Proposer tes idées et participer aux projets internes visant à fluidifier nos processus commerciaux. Déroulement du stage : • Deux semaines d’immersion : Découverte de nos métiers, de nos équipes et de notre vision globale. • Intégration à la Sales Academy : Tout du long de ton stage, tu bénéficieras d’un accompagnement sur mesure (formations techniques sur la copropriété, ateliers pratiques sur les méthodes de vente). • Suivi régulier : Des échanges hebdomadaires avec ton/ta manager pour accompagner ta montée en compétences et lever tes blocages. • Perspective d’évolution : En fonction de ta progression et de ton projet, tu pourras élargir ton champ d’apprentissage en découvrant les étapes suivantes du cycle de vente auprès de nos Account Executives. À la fin de ton stage, tu maîtriseras les techniques de vente, les cycles de vente complexes et les meilleurs outils utilisés par les start-ups. Tu participes au lancement de nouvelles offres, ce qui te permet de comprendre comment fonctionne l'entrepreneuriat. Les avantages : Salaire : 1 000€ (Césure) - 1 200€ (fin d'études de master) + une variable selon l’atteinte de tes objectifs Une forte montée en compétence sur les métiers de Sales, la vente complexe, la connaissance de l'environnement start-up et immobilier, Poursuite possible en CDI avec évolution en Account Executive par la suite, Une demi-journée de congé par mois Un ordinateur et équipements te seront fournis Carte ticket restaurant Swile (France) Abonnement à Gymlib (France), Informations pratiques : Localisation : Paris 10e Type de contrat : Stage conventionné Durée : 6 mois Date de démarrage : janvier Télétravail : selon les modalités en vigue

jobs.title: Identity & Access Management Engineer
jobs.description: Who is Sonar? Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow,  Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.   Position description We are looking for an experienced Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer to design, build, and operate the identity platforms that secure access to our applications, infrastructure, and data. You will own the technical direction of our IAM ecosystem, including authentication, authorization, lifecycle management, and privileged access. You will work with security, IT, engineering, and compliance teams to deliver a secure, scalable, and user-friendly access experience aligned with Zero Trust principles. What you will do Design, implement, and maintain enterprise IAM solutions, including SSO, MFA, federation, and directory services. Architect and manage identity lifecycle processes (joiner/mover/leaver), automating provisioning and deprovisioning across SaaS, cloud, and on-prem systems. Implement and operate Privileged Access Management (PAM), including vaulting, session management, and just-in-time access. Lead Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) initiatives such as access reviews, certifications, role-based access control (RBAC), and segregation-of-duties controls. Integrate applications with the identity platform using SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and LDAP. Develop automation and tooling (APIs, scripts, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code) to reduce manual identity operations. Secure cloud identity and access across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, including IAM policies, workload identity, and service accounts. Define and enforce authentication and authorization standards, policies, and best practices. Monitor identity-related threats and support detection and response for account compromise, credential abuse, and privilege escalation. Experience and qualifications 6 to 15 years of experience in IAM, security engineering, or a related field. Hands-on experience with at least one major IAM platform such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Ping Identity, ForgeRock, SailPoint, or CyberArk. Strong knowledge of identity protocols and standards: SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, LDAP, and Kerberos. Experience with Active Directory and directory services architecture. Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, PowerShell, Go, Java, or JavaScript). Solid understanding of cloud IAM models (AWS IAM, Azure RBAC, GCP IAM). Experience with MFA, passwordless, and conditional or risk-based access. Familiarity with Zero Trust, least privilege, and defense-in-depth principles. jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description: About Taurus Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech? Then we might just have the job for you. Taurus is a FINMA-regulated securities firm, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and a leading European provider of digital asset infrastructure solutions for banks, broker-dealers, corporates, and private companies. Using blockchain technology, our platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities and assets, digital currencies, and stablecoins. We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth. Tasks The Role We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our Project & Organization team. You will play a central role in managing high-impact projects — from the implementation of our platform within financial institutions to strategic cross-functional initiatives. Working closely with both clients and internal teams, you will help deliver a seamless, high-quality experience while contributing directly to Taurus's continued growth. This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and digital assets — ideal for someone eager to grow in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a resourceful, forward-thinking, and hands-on professional capable of driving strategic planning, operational execution, and client delivery in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Main Responsibilities Client-Facing Project Management: Lead end-to-end delivery projects for our clients (financial institutions, issuers, or LP/market makers). This includes designing operating models and workflows, setting up custody and tokenization platforms, and managing technical implementations in close collaboration with client teams and Taurus' Engineering and Security departments. Internal Strategy & Operations: Deliver cross-functional projects sponsored by the Executive Committee, working across Product, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Sales. Typical assignments involve regulatory filings, business requirement specifications, operational improvements, and international expansion Blockchain Forensics & Due Diligence: Produce high-quality source-of-funds analyses, wallet screening, and crypto due diligence reports using blockchain intelligence tools to support compliance reviews, onboarding, and investigations. Commercial & Operational Support: Contribute to sales RFPs/RFIs, support ad-hoc commercial or operational priorities across the company. Requirements Your Profile Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm or in project management within a financial services or fintech environment. Solid understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the broader digital asset ecosystem (custody, trading, tokenization, staking, derivatives, etc.). Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver with a high level of attention to detail. Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner. Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus. Willingness to travel to client locations as required Benefits What We Offer An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and traditional finance, with direct exposure to leading financial institutions. A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts in digital assets and blockchain. A fast-paced, entrepreneurial learning environment with strong team spirit. A great moment to join as Taurus grows and expands globally As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. There will be growth opportunities for candidates with an open mindset and a strong delivery track record. We are an equal opportunity employer. Note We will only consider direct applications and won't consider applications submitted via recruitment agencies.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer  (Excavator Automation)
jobs.description: Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.  Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.  Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.  The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.       About the Job The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. This role is at the intersection of system engineering, integration, field deployments, and debugging . We are looking for an engineer with a degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Robotics or relevant fields and at least 2 years of practical, hands-on experience working with real systems - and if they fail, you can help us figure out why. This is not an entry-level or new-graduate role . You will help define and execute system-level test scenarios , support atypical and beta deployments , and act as a technical bridge between the field and the engineering team. You will help train our field engineers and keep them in touch with fast evolving autonomy capabilities. What you will do Validate system behavior across machines, environments, and operating conditions Identify edge cases, failure modes, and operational limits Collaborate with engineering teams on making technical decisions on a system level Investigate system failure during field testing or deployments Apply hotfixes when appropriate Support or conduct deployments if needed, especially pilots or beta customers Support/conduct atypical deployments, pilots, and beta customers Capture lessons learned from deployments and feed them back into system testing and design Help prioritize fixes and improvements based on real-world impact What we're looking for Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or a closely related field 2+ years of hands-on experience working with complex systems (automation, robotics, vehicles, heavy machinery, industrial equipment, or similar) Strong system-level troubleshooting and debugging skills C++ and Python programming skills, proficiency in git systems Proficiency in Linux systems Comfortable working in field environments (construction sites, test yards, deployments) Ability to travel abroad, according to needs of the business Driver’s license B category Beneficial Experience with excavators, heavy equipment, or off-road vehicles Field testing experience Familiarity with communication technologies such as DDS, Zenoh, LCM etc. Experience in motion planning or control Experience in robotic competitions Don't meet every requirement? If you're enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn't match every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect candidate for this or other positions. This is an opportunity to join a dynamic, multidisciplinary team and to be part of a company that is reshaping heavy construction. Gravis is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team, and do not discriminate based on race, colour, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characterist

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Robotics Platform
jobs.description: Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.  Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.  Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.  The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.   About the Job At Gravis, we build high tech systems that give machine operators superhuman capabilities. To adapt in real time to changes in the environment the Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into an autonomous control system. The robotics platform team builds the software foundation for our robots to enable non stop operation in the harshest environments. We ensure all algorithms execute correctly, based on a rock solid communication layer and world class introspection capabilities. We provide all the tools to deploy, develop and debug the most powerful robots on earth. As a robotics platform staff software engineer, you will help shape and implement our vision of a scalable, safe and high performing robotics platform. You will  gather requirements from internal customers, architect the communication layer, node orchestration and lifecycle management as well as APIs to off-machine systems. The main focus will be on the design, implementation and maintenance of essential parts of the on-robot platform, contributing to open source projects where feasible. With your outstanding skills, you will be a role model for other developers in our organisation and guide them on their professional journey.  What you'll do Collaborate closely with engineers from other teams  to derive requirements and help shape the vision of our robotics platform  Derive roadmaps towards our vision, incorporating business needs and handling conflicting timelines and requirements Design, build and maintain parts of the robotics platform, e.g. health monitoring and machine configuration management. jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About Hilo by Aktiia High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.  We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.  We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship. Role Overview As Influencer Marketing Manager, you will develop and run Hilo’s influencer marketing program across our key markets. You will find creators whose voices and audiences fit our brand, negotiate effective partnerships, and shape content that makes Hilo relevant and credible. The role combines brand and performance: you will use data to estimate the potential of each partnership before we invest, measure its results, and apply what you learn to future campaigns. Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required. Core Responsibilities Identify, assess, and recruit creators across relevant platforms and markets. Develop campaign concepts that balance Hilo’s brand goals with measurable commercial outcomes. Forecast likely reach, engagement, traffic, and acquisition outcomes to guide creator selection and budgets. Negotiate fees, deliverables, timelines, and content usage rights, including rights to use creator content in paid campaigns. Manage partnerships end to end, from briefing and content review through publication and reporting. Build and nurture long-term relationships with creators and brand ambassadors to drive sustained awareness, trust, and advocacy. Collaborate with paid media teams to amplify high-performing creator content across paid social and other relevant channels. Set clear goals, track brand and performance metrics, and compare results with initial estimates. Use campaign data and audience insights to improve creator selection, content formats, and investment decisions. Work across marketing and product to align campaigns with Hilo’s priorities and approved health claims. Build repeatable processes that support growth across the US, UK, Germany, and other markets. Requirements Background & Experience At least 2 years of hands-on influencer or creator marketing experience, including managing partnerships from start to finish. A data-driven mindset: you can estimate campaign outcomes, assess performance, and turn findings into better decisions. Strong creative judgment and an understanding of how creator content builds both brand trust and customer demand. Strong negotiation skills and confidence working with creators and their representatives. Excellent communication, organization, and attention to detail. Fluency in English; German is a plus. Experience in health tech, wellness, medical devices, or another category where trust and accurate claims matter is welcome. Benefits What Makes You A Great Fit At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:  Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. jobs.description: Waarom jij hier JA op zegt! ✔ Werken aan data-oplossingen én AI-initiatieven met directe impact op de business ✔ Veel vrijheid, autonomie en ruimte voor eigen ideeën ✔ Salaris van maximaal €5.000 bruto per maand o.b.v. 40 uur en afhankelijk van ervaring ✔ Werken in een klein, wendbaar team zonder corporate bureaucratie ✔ 28 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband + mogelijkheid om 5 dagen bij te kopen In deze rol ben je in de eerste plaats verantwoordelijk voor het bouwen en verbeteren van data-oplossingen. Je zorgt ervoor dat data beschikbaar, betrouwbaar en bruikbaar is voor de organisatie door data pipelines, dashboards en integraties te ontwikkelen. Tegelijkertijd krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van AI binnen Rail Innovators Group. AI vormt daarbij een waardevolle aanvulling op de rol, maar de basis ligt in data engineering en business intelligence. Je werkt aan uiteenlopende vraagstukken, van stuurinformatie voor de business tot innovatieve AI-toepassingen die processen slimmer en efficiënter maken. Rail Innovators Group Rail Innovators Group, opgericht in 2005 en gevestigd in Rotterdam, is een internationale specialist in goederenvervoer per spoor. Met meer dan 250 railprofessionals zijn wij actief in 23 landen en vervoeren wij jaarlijks meer dan 6 miljoen ton aan vracht. Onze moderne vloot bestaat uit hoogwaardige locomotieven, een breed scala aan wagons en intermodale units. Daarmee bieden wij flexibele, betrouwbare en duurzame transportoplossingen in heel Europa en daarbuiten. Via onze vier bedrijven Raillogix, Rail Force One, Railrelease en CWS verzorgen wij de volledige railketen: van planning en tractie tot leasing en onderhoud. Wat ga je doen? Je werkt aan uiteenlopende data- en AI-vraagstukken die bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming, efficiëntere processen en verdere digitalisering van de organisatie. Je werkt vanuit een backlog en roadmap, waarbij je samen met de business bepaalt welke oplossingen de meeste waarde toevoegen. Daarbij schakel je met verschillende stakeholders, van finance en operations tot directie. Concreet betekent dit dat je: Data pipelines bouwt en onderhoudt Verschillende databronnen integreert en ontsluit Dashboards en rapportages ontwikkelt waarmee de business kan sturen De data-architectuur verder professionaliseert en verbetert Businessvragen vertaalt naar concrete data-oplossingen Prioriteiten stelt op basis van impact en business value Werkt binnen een Agile omgeving met tweewekelijkse sprints Actief meebouwt aan de verdere AI-volwassenheid van de organisatie Wie ben jij? Iemand die analytisch sterk is, zelfstandig werkt en energie krijgt van complexe vraagstukken. Je vindt het leuk om techniek en business met elkaar te verbinden en durft kritisch mee te denken wanneer een antwoord niet de juiste oplossing lijkt. Dit past bij iemand die: Beschikt over HBO werk- en denkniveau Een opleiding heeft afgerond richting IT, Informatica, Bedrijfskundige Informatica, Econometrie of vergelijkbaar Communicatief sterk is en gemakkelijk schakelt met verschillende stakeholders Analytisch en probleemoplossend ingesteld is Zelfstandig werkt, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en prioriteiten weet te stellen Affiniteit met IT heeft De Nederlandse taal goed beheerst, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk Daarnaast is het mooi meegenomen als je ervaring hebt met: Data Engineering, SQL en ETL Business Intelligence AI-oplossingen en tooling zoals ChatGPT of Claude Agile of Scrum werkwijzen Heb je nog niet overal ervaring mee, maar beschik je over een sterk analytisch vermogen en een hoge leercurve? Dan nodigen we je ook van harte uit om te reageren Wat bieden wij? Het salaris voor deze functie bedraagt maximaal €5.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring Je krijgt 28 vakantiedagen op fulltime basis, met daarnaast de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen bij te kopen Daarnaast ontvang je een winstafhankelijke bonusregeling en profiteer je van een uitstekende pensi

jobs.title: Meewerk Stage Continuous Improvement (Power BI & Power Automate)
jobs.description: Ben jij analytisch sterk en wil je impact maken binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan moeten we jou hebben! Jouw rol Bij Heras krijg je de kans om als stagiair bij te dragen aan het Nimble-programma: een strategisch verbeterprogramma gericht op het vereenvoudigen en automatiseren van bedrijfsprocessen. Als stagiair werk je aan het verbeteren van processen binnen domeinen zoals sales, projecten in nieuwbouw en finance. Je analyseert hoe processen vandaag werken en vertaalt dit naar slimme oplossingen met behulp van Power BI en Power Automate. Je levert concrete procesverbeteringen, procesbeschrijvingen, automatiseringen en Power BI dashboards voor operationele en financiële sturing aan alsmede werkende Power Automate flows. Tenslotte lever je een meetbare bijdrage aan efficiëntie (bijv. tijdbesparing of minder fouten). Jouw werkzaamheden In kaart brengen van huidige processen en knelpunten. Automatiseren van handmatige processen met Power Automate. Ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages in Power BI (zonder daadwerkelijk programmeren). Verbeteren van datakwaliteit en inzicht in KPI’s. Samenwerken met business teams en IT-specialisten. Benieuwd naar de ervaringen van een stagiair bij Heras? De eerste indruk: dynamisch in plaats van stoffig - Heras Nederland Wie zijn wij? Heras is een vooraanstaand Europese totaalleverancier van permanente perimeter protection oplossingen. Wij opereren vanuit meer dan 24 landen en hebben meer dan 1100 hoogopgeleide experts in dienst. Opgericht in 1952, vervult en overtreft Heras de beveiligingsbehoeften van klanten in heel Europa. Het is dankzij deze staat van dienst, samen met het blijvend groeiende vakmanschap van onze medewerkers, dat wij ons experts in perimeter protection kunnen noemen. Onze cultuur, werksfeer & waarden Wij hebben binnen Heras een informele, open en toegankelijke cultuur. We zijn trots op ons werk, producten en dienstverlening. We hebben een no-nonsense mentaliteit, tonen ondernemerschap, zijn energiek en werken allemaal gedisciplineerd volgens de drie kernwaarden; betrokkenheid, betrouwbaarheid en deskundigheid. Heras is gewaardeerd op een Ecovadis Zilveren Ster en dat plaatst ons bij de duurzaamste 15% bedrijven van Nederland. Onze doelstelling is streven naar Goud in de komende jaren en volledig CO2 neutraal zijn in 2050. Wil je hier meer over weten? https://www.heras.nl/over-heras/kwaliteit-en-veiligheid/ Jouw profiel Je volgt een HBO- of WO-opleiding (bijv. Bedrijfskunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde, IT, Data of Finance) Je zoekt een 3e of 4e jaars stage waarbij de nadruk ligt op meewerken of bouwen van dashboarding Je hebt interesse in procesverbetering en data Je hebt basiskennis van of affiniteit met Power BI en/of Power Automate Je bent analytisch, proactief en communicatief sterk Onze voorkeur gaat uit naar een kandidaat die de Nederlandse taal goed beheerst Hoewel het niet zelf programmeren beterft vindt je het wel leuk om zelf oplossingen te verzinnen en te testen Wat bieden wij jou? Bij Heras bieden wij jou een meewerkstage binnen een zeer dynamische omgeving waarbij elke dag anders is met veel variatie en afwisseling. Je draagt je steentje bij aan een veilige omgeving en helpt om onze samenleving te beschermen. Tenslotte zijn er volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien. Wij bieden het volgende: Stagevergoeding van €500,- bruto o.b.v. fulltime 2 verlofdagen per maand Flexibiliteit en vrijheid Reiskostenvergoeding van 0,23ct per kilometer tussen 5- en 60km enkele reis Laptop voor gebruik bij Heras Iets voor jou? Voor externe partijen: Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Heras behoudt hiermee het recht om ingestuurde kandidaten rechtstreeks te benaderen. Our live and historical traffic products — flow, jams, and speed profiles — power navigation, ADAS, and mobility decisions for the world's leading automotive OEMs, enterprises, and ride-hailing companies. As these customers move faster and expect richer, more accurate content, the way we generate, moderate, and deliver traffic data becomes a decisive competitive advantage. What you'll do Own and deliver against Traffic Flow, Traffic Jams, and Speed Profiles — setting the roadmap, OKRs, and quality bar, and taking a leading role in product quality. Focus on outcomes over outputs, tracking metrics such as ETT accuracy, jam detection quality, traffic coverage, and speed profile coverage. Gather deep customer insights from automotive OEMs, government agencies, and enterprise clients, separating high-value initiatives from nice-to-haves. The centre of the role is backend development in Python or Go and cloud infrastructure, with some front-end work alongside. At Deepdesk, we are building “Augmented Intelligence” for the enterprise. We use machine learning to provide agents with real-time recommendations and autocomplete suggestions, supporting them in efficiently assisting customers. Alongside recommendations, we offer fully virtual assistants that can take care of repetitive tasks. You will work on the services behind this: the Python and Go services and APIs, the data stores and the cloud infrastructure that run our product for enterprise customers, including the services that serve our recommendation models. You will also pick up front-end work where it helps the product, for example in our admin interface and widgets. We are also building voice agents: AI that talks with customers in real time. Speech is turned into text, a language model works out the answer, and the answer is spoken back, all within a fraction of a second. You will help build and run the services behind this, in Python and Go. We have a start-up culture, but your code is directly used and proven at scale. Our technology is cutting-edge and continually evolving. What You’ll Be Doing •  Build and maintain backend services and APIs in Python and Go, with background processing for heavy work. •  Keep our databases fast and reliable. •  Run and improve our infrastructure on Google Cloud: Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines. •  Build and run the real-time voice agent services: speech to text, language model and text to speech, with low latency, in Python and Go. •  Help deploy and run the machine learning services behind our recommendations. Machine learning experience is not required. •  Design and provide complete and accurate end-to-end metrics. •  Write and review well-tested, clean and maintainable code. •  Follow software engineering best practices while staying pragmatic and avoiding over-engineering. •  Contribute to front-end features in TypeScript and React when needed. Our Stack •  Backend: Python (Django REST framework, FastAPI and Celery) and Go. •  Voice: Go for our real-time voice AI service, with WebSockets, speech to text, language models, text to speech and the OpenAI Realtime API. •  Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse and Elasticsearch. •  Cloud: Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Flux and Cloud Build. •  Front end: TypeScript and React. •  Quality: automated tests (pytest, and BDD integration tests written in Go), code review on every change, and automation to keep our code and delivery practices in shape. What We’re Looking For •  Strong professional experience building backend services in Python or Go. In Python, Django or FastAPI is a plus. •  Solid knowledge of relational databases, in particular PostgreSQL. •  Hands-on experience with containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD. Google Cloud is a plus. •  Working knowledge of TypeScript and React, enough to build and fix front-end features. It does not need to be your strength. •  A disciplined approach to testing, code review, maintainability and delivery. •  Comfort working with autonomy and taking full ownership in a fast-moving environment. •  Interest in voice and real-time system

jobs.description: Insurance is a numbers business, and most of those numbers are harder to trust than they look. You would lead the team that defines the numbers Insify runs on, from the event a customer fires on our website to the report a risk carrier audits months later. About the Role You would lead our Data & Analytics team of 3-4 engineers end to end: ingestion, the warehouse and its models, the metric layer, and the analysis and reporting built on top of it. It is a small team with a big surface, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach. We are deliberately not splitting data engineering from analytics. At our size the hard problems sit in the handover between the two, and we want one person who enjoys that whole puzzle. The team serves four groups with genuinely different needs. Growth wants hourly to daily signals and can live with approximately right. Carrier reporting and corporate finance are calendar-locked and need numbers that reconcile and survive an audit months later. Actuarial needs depth and lineage over speed. Prioritising here is arbitration between things that fail in different ways, and the arbitration is yours. It's a hands-on role. You can open the warehouse and read the models, you review a new data model before it ships, and your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it. The job is still the team: its own game, its communication, and each person in it. When something slips, hands-on work is the first thing that yields. What you'll be doing Leading a team of 3-4 data engineers and analysts end to end: what it builds, how it runs in production, and who you hire and grow to get there Running discovery with the teams we serve: understanding what they need from data, and bringing the platform and datasets that enable them Owning the trade-offs between Growth, carrier reporting, finance and actuarial: deciding what the team works on, driving alignment with key partners across other teams, and saying no when the answer is no Making the platform scale: a new country, carrier or product should mean configuration and reused models, and recurring manual work, like carrier reporting and cash reconciliation, should turn into automation Bringing engineering excellence to how the team works: data contracts with product teams, testing in CI, alerts that get resolved, a way to try changes before they hit production Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others What you'll need You've managed or led a data team before, including hiring, feedback and growing people. jobs.title: Shift Supervisor | DSL-01
jobs.description: Shift Supervisor | DSL-01 Voor DSL-01 in Delfzijl zoeken wij een ervaren Shift Supervisor die vanaf de voorbereidingsfase meebouwt aan de operatie. Iemand die meedenkt over procedures, voorbereiding van de commissioning en startup en helpt om operators klaar te stomen voor het moment waarop de installatie daadwerkelijk gaat draaien. DSL-01 wordt een grootschalige productiefaciliteit voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) en bijproducten. Over de functie Als Shift Supervisor speel je een sleutelrol in de veilige, stabiele en efficiënte operatie van DSL-01. In deze functie krijg je een unieke combinatie van projectwerk en operationele verantwoordelijkheid. Tijdens de huidige projectfase draag je in dagdienst actief bij aan de voorbereiding van de fabrieksoperatie, commissioning en startup. Zodra DSL-01 operationeel is, gepland vanaf voorjaar 2028, geef je (in ploegendienst) leiding aan een ploeg operators en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van een complexe chemische productie-installatie. Je zorgt ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en milieudoelstellingen worden behaald en neemt de leiding wanneer zich afwijkingen, storingen of noodsituaties voordoen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain en HSES. Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is dat je niet instapt in een bestaande organisatie, maar vanaf het begin meebouwt aan de operatie, productie en manier van werken. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Tijdens de project- en opstartfase (~1,5 jaar): Werk je in dagdienst Draag je bij aan de commissioning en inbedrijfstelling van DSL-01 Ontwikkel je procedures en werkinstructies Speel je een belangrijke rol in het uitvoeren van trainingsprogramma's en het trainen van operators Ondersteun je bij de opbouw van de operationele organisatie Zorg je voor een succesvolle voorbereiding op de start van de fabriek. In de operationele fase (vanaf medio 2028): Geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 8 operators in een 5-ploegendienst binnen een volcontinu productieproces. Bewaak je de veilige en efficiënte productie van SAF, propaan, butaan en nafta. Monitor je procesprestaties via DCS- en MES-systemen, stuur je bij waar nodig en zorg je ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits- en rendementsdoelstellingen worden gerealiseerd. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het naleven van veiligheids-, milieu- en kwaliteitsstandaarden, neem je de leiding bij incidenten en calamiteiten en coördineer je werkzaamheden tussen Operations, Maintenance en andere betrokken disciplines. Ook speel je een actieve rol in het continu verbeteren van processen en het verder versterken van de veiligheidscultuur binnen de fabriek. Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het ontwikkelen van het operationele team. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de groei van operators, zowel op technisch vlak als in competenties zoals samenwerking, eigenaarschap en veiligheidsbewustzijn. Door coaching, begeleiding en duidelijke verwachtingen zorg je voor een sterk team dat veilig, effectief en met vertrouwen kan opereren. Jouw profiel SkyNRG is een groeiende organisatie in een snel ontwikkelende markt. Daarom zoeken we mensen die zich prettig voelen in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt en die actief willen bijdragen aan de verdere opbouw van de organisatie. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, denkt vooruit en voelt je op je plek in een omgeving die continu in beweging is. jobs.title: Embedded Engineer
jobs.description: Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Medior–Senior, ~5 years of relevant experience About us AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase: a small, growing team turning lab setups into a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet. The role As Embedded Engineer you own everything between the instrument hardware and our acquisition software. You integrate cameras, frame grabbers, motion controllers, piezo stages, lasers and FPGA timing hardware, and you make them run as one synchronized, reliable scan. The work is hands-on: vendor SDKs, trigger wiring, PCIe cards and lab networks one day, clean driver code and a live data stream to the user interface the next. You work closely with the System, Mechatronics, Application and Algorithm engineers. What you will do Design the trigger and acquisition architecture that synchronizes camera exposure, stage motion and laser pulses. Integrate industrial cameras and frame grabbers through industry-standard interfaces and vendor SDKs, from driver set-up to stable high-rate acquisition. Integrate motion controllers and positioning stages through vendor APIs and controller scripting, including commissioning and tuning with the Mechatronics Engineer. Develop and extend FPGA-based timing and I/O for triggering and position-synchronized acquisition. Write driver and control layers in C/C++ and Python that the scan and reconstruction software builds on, and expose live status and data streams to the user interface. Own the instrument PC and lab network set-up: PCIe hardware, high-speed Ethernet links between devices, IP planning and device discovery. Bring up and debug hardware in the lab with oscilloscope, logic analyzer and network captures, and document interfaces and timing budgets with the System Engineer. Take part in code review and help move the set-up from prototype to a reproducible, maintainable tool. Your profile MSc in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Applied Physics or a related field. ~5 years of hands-on experience integrating and controlling hardware, preferably in high-tech equipment, scientific instruments or industrial automation. Strong C/C++ and Python, including working with vendor SDKs and drivers on Windows and Linux. Proven experience with hardware triggering and synchronization of multiple devices (cameras, motion, lasers, DAQ). Experience with FPGA development or working closely with FPGA-based timing hardware. Solid grasp of hardware interfaces and networking: Ethernet, USB, serial, PCIe, and multi-device lab networks. Comfortable in the lab: reading schematics, using an oscilloscope and logic analyzer, and debugging where hardware and software meet. Experience with Git and collaborative code review. Full professional proficiency in English. We value judgment and ownership over a perfect match. If you recognize yourself in most of this, we would like to hear from you. Bonus Experience with machine-vision cameras, frame grabbers or high-throughput image acquisition. Experience with precision motion controllers and encoder-based position triggering. High-speed data paths to a host PC, SoC FPGAs or Linux driver development. Experience building lightweight web or API layers for instrument control and live data. Background in optics, lasers, coherent imaging, semiconductor metrology or lithography equipment. Experience with CI, hardware-in-the-loop testing, or working in a Scrum team. What we offer Ownership of the embedded and timing backbone of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet. A small team with short feedback loops and real impact on the product. Hands-on work at the meeting point of hardware, optics and software, on the High Tech Campus Eindhoven. A competitive salary for the Dutch market. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Project Controller (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Project Controller (m/w/d) Einsatzort: Linden (Hessen) oder Berlin Arbeitszeit: 40 hours/week Bitte beachten Sie: Diese Rolle ist ausschließlich vor Ort in Linden auszuüben Über uns ITM Power ist ein führendes Unternehmen in der Branche für grünen Wasserstoff und entwickelt und fertigt hochmoderne PEM-Elektrolyseure, die eine Schlüsselrolle bei der weltweiten Dekarbonisierung spielen. Mit über zwei Jahrzehnten wissenschaftlicher Expertise haben wir uns als Branchenführer im Bereich der sauberen Energietechnologie etabliert. Unsere Standorte in Deutschland dienen als zentrale Drehscheibe innerhalb der EU und beherbergen Teams aus den Bereichen Geschäftsentwicklung, Engineering, Beschaffung und Kundendienst, um unseren Kunden schnelle und effiziente Lösungen zu bieten. ITM Power befindet sich in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase und konzentriert sich auf die effiziente Umsetzung von Projekten. Wir suchen motivierte Talente, die unsere Leidenschaft für saubere Energie teilen und aktiv zur globalen Energiewende beitragen möchten. Der Projektcontroller ist für die Verwaltung des Gesamtprojektzeitplans und die Kontrolle der Projektkosten verantwortlich und stellt sicher, dass die Ausgaben im Rahmen des Projektbudgets bleiben. Zu den Aufgaben dieser Position gehören die Erstellung von Kostenberichten, die Analyse der finanziellen Leistung im Zusammenhang mit dem Projektplan sowie die Beratung von Projektmanagern und Stakeholdern hinsichtlich Strategien zum Kostenmanagement. Der Projektcontroller arbeitet eng mit den Finanz- und Projektmanagement-Teams zusammen, um eine genaue Kostenverfolgung und Berichterstattung sicherzustellen. Sie unterstützen Projekte, indem Sie an internen und externen Kosten- und Terminüberprüfungen teilnehmen sowie die Kostenverfolgung und -abstimmung durchführen. Darüber hinaus führt diese Position regelmäßige Überprüfungen und Aktualisierungen des Projektrisikoregisters durch. Sie koordinieren die gesamten Projektsteuerungsaktivitäten unabhängig von Umfang und Komplexität, einschließlich Turnkey- und Pauschalprojekten, unter vollständiger Einhaltung der vertraglichen Anforderungen. Ihre Aufgaben Sie arbeiten gemeinsam mit dem Projektteam an der Entwicklung von Projektsteuerungsstrategien und -plänen, die mit den Projektzielen und vertraglichen Anforderungen übereinstimmen In dieser Position überwachen, analysieren und berichten Sie über den Projektfortschritt, die Kostenentwicklung und bestehende Projektrisiken, gemeinsam mit dem Projektmanager entwickeln Sie Maßnahmen, um kritische Bereiche anzugehen und die Projektziele zu erreichen Sie stellen die Genauigkeit, Vollständigkeit und Konsistenz der Projektsteuerungsdaten und -informationen sicher und implementieren Qualitätssicherungsprozesse, um zuverlässige und einheitliche Projektergebnisse zu gewährleisten Sie entwickeln und pflegen Projektzeitpläne und arbeiten mit den Projektteammitgliedern zusammen, um wichtige Projektmeilensteine zu identifizieren und kritische Pfade zu analysieren Darüber hinaus überwachen Sie die Projektkosten im Vergleich zum Budget und zur Prognose, erstellen gemeinsam mit den Projektmanagern Kostenschätzungen, identifizieren Kostenabweichungen und entwickeln entsprechende Korrekturmaßnahmen Sie steuern die Prozesse zum Änderungsmanagement (Change Orders), um sicherzustellen, dass Änderungen ordnungsgemäß dokumentiert und in die Projektpläne sowie Kostenschätzungen integriert werden Sie überwachen und überprüfen den Verbrauch von Arbeitsstunden im Verhältnis zu den erbrachten Leistungen und identifizieren Änderungen, die sich auf das erforderliche Budget auswirken Sie identifizieren terminliche Herausforderungen und Probleme, die sich aus Einschränkungen oder Schnittstellen zwischen verschiedenen Fachbereichen und Funktionen ergeben Sie überwachen und berichten über den kritischen Pfad sowie die Terminplanentwicklung des Gesamtprojekts Sie empfehlen dem Projektteam alternative Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung des Terminplans und bringen

jobs.title: Vice President - AI Financial Advisory (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über Finton Finton ist eine AI-Native Finance-Beratung, die AI-gestützte Lösungen für den CFO-Bereich konzipiert und implementiert. Unsere Services erbringen wir mit unserer eigenen Software, die den Berater von Projektmanagement über Datenverarbeitung bis zu Datenanalyse und Dashboard-Erstellung durchgängig mit AI unterstützt. Konkret heißt das: Wir setzen auf dem bestehenden ERP, der Buchhaltung und den operativen Systemen des Kunden auf, bringen die Daten zusammen und liefern in kürzester Zeit ein produktives Ergebnis, etwa ein monatliches Management Reporting mit Kommentierung, einen rollierenden 13-Wochen-Cash-Forecast, eine Deckungsbeitrags- und Umsatzanalyse nach Kunden, Produkten oder Projekten oder einen Datenraum und ein Financial Fact Book für eine anstehende Transaktion. Daneben arbeiten wir klassisch beratend: als Sparringspartner des CFO bei Budget, Forecast und Investorenkommunikation, als Interim-Kapazität in der Finanzabteilung und als Unterstützung bei M&A, Fundraising und Due-Diligence-Vorbereitung. Unsere Kunden sind mittelständische und investorenfinanzierte Unternehmen mit typischerweise 10 bis 250 Mio. Euro Umsatz, bei denen das Finance-Team für die Anforderungen von Gesellschaftern und Banken zu klein oder zu manuell aufgestellt ist. Finton wurde 2023 von Jan, Julian und Neil gegründet und betreut Kunden in der gesamten DACH-Region von Hamburg, Köln und München aus. Mehr als 150 abgeschlossene Projekte sprechen für sich. Deine Aufgaben Projektleitung: Du führst Projekte mit Bestands- und Neukunden eigenständig, steuerst Scope, Timeline und Qualität und bringst Use Cases in wenigen Wochen vom Konzept in den Live-Betrieb. Kundenverantwortung: Du trägst die P&L-Verantwortung für deine Mandate, erkennst Potenziale für Upselling und Cross-Selling und entwickelst deine Kunden zu langfristigen Partnerschaften. Office of the CFO: Du analysierst bestehende Finanzprozesse, konzipierst Management Reporting, Cash Forecasting, Margen- und Umsatzanalysen und setzt sie gemeinsam mit unserem Tech-Team auf den Systemen des Kunden um. Sparring und Transaktionen: Du arbeitest auf Augenhöhe mit CFOs und Geschäftsführern, unterstützt bei Budgets, Finanzmodellen, Bewertungen und begleitest Transaktionen, Fundraisings und Due-Diligence-Vorbereitungen. Business Development: Du bringst dich in Angebote und Pitches ein, baust dein eigenes Netzwerk aus und gewinnst gemeinsam mit den Gründern neue Kunden. Produktentwicklung : Mit Deinem Feedback unterstützt das Technologie-Team bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer AI-Platform. Teamaufbau: Du führst und entwickelst jüngere Kolleginnen und Kollegen in deinen Projekten und prägst unsere Arbeitsweise mit. Das bringst Du mit Erfahrung: 3 bis 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Financial Advisory (Investment Banking, Transaction Advisory, Consulting, Restructuring) oder im Office of the CFO eines Growth-Unternehmens, in dem du die Finanzabteilung mit aufgebaut hast. Handwerk: Du hast Reporting, Budgets und Finanzmodelle gebaut und bringst Erfahrung in Unternehmensbewertung, M&A oder Fundraising mit. jobs.description: Role Profile Job Title: Data Centre Architect Reports to: Head of Data Centre Development Location: UK hybrid Company Overview: Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments. We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software. As we scale, we’re building this organisation from the ground up. We’re looking for people who’d rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of team you’ve previously managed. This is a senior individual contributor role with authority to sign off technical schedules, working with cluster and network architects, NVIDIA and other OEM engineers, colocation provider engineering and sales teams, and the internal Procurement, Legal, Finance and Site Operations teams. What You’ll Do You will be the single technical authority between our GPU-as-a-service business and the colocation providers that host our NVIDIA clusters. You turn cluster architecture and OEM requirements into a precise, contractable statement of work (SOW) for the data centre white space, then hold the provider to it through design, installation and acceptance. We are growing from tens of megawatts to hundreds, on rack-scale liquid-cooled platforms at 130 kW per rack and rising to 200 kW and beyond. Mistakes in power, cooling or fibre specification show up as stranded capacity, delayed cluster delivery and disputes, so the role carries real commercial weight. Key Responsibilities Technical negotiation with colocation providers Lead technical due diligence on candidate sites: power availability and energisation dates, redundancy topology, liquid-cooling capability, floor loading, rack logistics, fibre and meet-me access. Challenge provider claims with evidence: single-line diagrams, P&IDs, load-bank and commissioning records, reference customers. Specification & SOW Work with cluster architects and OEMs (NVIDIA first) to capture rack, power, cooling, network and layout requirements, and keep them current across product generations. Write and own the technical SOW for white-space fitout: containment and cooling interfaces, power distribution to rack, structured cabling and pathways, rack and POD layout, security zoning, labelling and records. Define clear scope boundaries and responsibilities between us, the colocation provider, OEMs and installation contractors, with no gaps and no overlaps. Maintain a requirements baseline with traceability from OEM document, to SOW clause, to acceptance test. Design, installation & acceptance Review provider and contractor designs, shop drawings and method statements against the SOW; run design reviews and close findings. Define acceptance: factory and site tests, liquid flush and cleanliness, power quality, thermal performance at full load, fibre loss, burn-in, and the evidence pack needed for each gate. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in. Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits. We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors. Why we're hiring We are automating a decades old part of the financial services industry. AI pilled builders like you are the beating heart of this plan, because LLMs & agents allow us to turn this services business entirely into software. This is a product role, and your product is how Odin operates. Think of it as our ghostbuster: every operational problem lands with you, you decide what gets fixed, and you ship most of the fixes yourself rather than writing tickets for someone else. The next goal is 7,000 deals a year and billions in annual investment flows. We believe this can be achieved with a team of around 50 people. Your job is to take each one apart, question why it exists, then rebuild it or kill it. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it's a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand. We're looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Brand Integrated Marketing to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us take ideas from global strategy through to local activation across markets, delivering integrated campaigns that drive measurable business growth. What You'll Be Doing You'll be joining the Integrated Marketing team. We own the Deliveroo brand globally and lead our biggest campaign moments. Working in a cross-functional squad alongside strategic teams, functional leads, and local markets, we turn big ideas into high-impact campaigns across our markets. Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with cross-functional squads, strategic teams, functional leads, and local market leads to align campaign strategies with core business goals. Stakeholder Management: Influence senior stakeholders across the global organisation without direct authority, ensuring alignment on messaging, execution, and performance metrics. Strategic Optimisation: Balance tactical execution with a longer-term strategic perspective to solve complex marketing briefs and continuously optimize brand performance. What You'll Need to Thrive Essential Integrated Brand Leadership: Proven experience leading end-to-end global integrated marketing campaigns from initial strategy through to local market activation. Framework Development: Strong track record in establishing measurement frameworks, campaign playbooks, and operational systems that scale across multiple regions. Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior cross-functional stakeholders and matrix teams without direct line management authority. Strategic & Tactical Execution: Proven ability to operate independently on complex or ambiguous briefs, balancing day-to-day execution with longer-term brand strategy. Commercial Acumen: Strong expertise in linking brand initiatives and marketing campaigns directly to measurable business growth and commercial impact. Nice to Have Experience navigating three-sided marketplace dynamics or fast-paced consumer tech environments. Background working across international or multi-market structures. Why Join Us? jobs.title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
jobs.description: What Quadrants is Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research. The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton. It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public. The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast. The role You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap. Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further. It calls for two things at once: the low-level GPU and compiler skill to make a single kernel optimal, and the ability to keep the whole system coherent as it grows. The core tradeoff is settled: usability comes first. When usability and performance collide, usability wins, unless the cost is severe. We will limit what the system supports to go fast (static shapes and fixed-size allocation baked into kernels, say), but never the convenience of the API itself. Experts who want maximum performance and full control over the generated code get lower-level escape hatches, down to inline assembly, C, or PTX. Your mandate is to build the best open-source Python compiler for physics simulation out there. No limit on what that takes. If it means replacing the entire engine, your call. Either way, you keep Quadrants healthy and unblocking the company in the meantime. What you’ll own API & authoring experience. The surface that physics and numerical-computing engineers write against, and, as an open-source library, the product’s face to the world. Idiomatic, natural to Python users, never a separate language bolted onto Python. Clean decorators, legible constraints, sharp errors, real escape hatches. IR, lowering & backends. A stable IR that lowers to multiple backends, with room to grow and the door kept open for differentiable simulation. Today the computation graph is expressed through Quadrants’ own constructs. Recovering it automatically from ordinary Python is hard, and a long-term goal rather than today’s reality. Optimization. Turn naive code into strong execution plans: vectorization, register and shared-memory usage, barriers and atomics, cooperative threading, dead-buffer and redundant-traffic elimination, dropping needless synchronization. Move low-level optimization off users and into the platform. Primitives. Cholesky, eigendecomposition, matmul, reductions, solver kernels. Each owned with its correctness, benchmarks, and regression tracking. Watching Genesis and the compiler together. Hunt for performance wins on both sides, in Genesis and in Quadrants itself. Propose API changes that cut duplication, improve readability, and reduce platform-specific special-casing. Less to maintain, more that simply works. The project as a product. Benchmark
